evidence: Figure 1 : System diagram for GraF-VTA . The STL specification is represented as a syntax tree and a deterministic finite automaton (DFA), both encoded by GNNs. Logic tokens from the syntax tree and visual tokens from multi-view observations are fused through bidirectional cross-attention. The fused features, DFA embedding, and current state condition a Temporal U-Net to generate the planned trajectory via an ODE solver.
